english.title: Leave / attempt to leave dock estate with goods without authority - Port of Liverpool
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) whilst

(A)_[carrying goods,]_
(B)_[having goods upon or with you,]_
(C)_[carrying goods in or upon a vehicle,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY GOODS..)

(C)_[left]_
(D)_[attempted to leave]_

the dock estate

(E)_[without having obtained the requisite pass to remove such goods]_
(F)_[and failed to produce the requisite pass to remove such goods upon demand]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 37(a) and 39(a) of the Port of Liverpool General Byelaws 2021.
